name: Seismic Sense

abilities.text: Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of lands you control. You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

notes: X is the count expression lands-you-control. optional is the 'You may' (none need be taken), reveal the reveal, filter the creature-or-land restriction, and rest/order the random bottom.

issues: You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. — expected Only the single card taken is revealed; the other X-1 cards looked at stay hidden information. — scripted dig {reveal:true}. game.ts:1090 applies reveal to the WHOLE looked-at set before any choice — `for (const c of top) this.reveal(c.id)` plus a public 'library reveal' event listing every card name. So casting Seismic Sense broadcasts the top X of your library to the table instead of at most one card. Dropping reveal (slightly under-revealing) is closer than the current over-reveal. — CR CR 701.16a

Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of lands you control. — expected X = lands you control, evaluated on resolution. — scripted look:{count:'lands-you-control'} — characteristics.ts:147 counts lands on your battlefield. Correct.

You may ... put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. — expected Taking is optional, the taken card must be a creature or land, the remainder goes to the bottom in a random order. — scripted take:1, optional:true (exact:false, so zero may be taken), filter:{types:['Creature','Land']} restricts the eligible set, rest:'bottom' + order:'random' shuffles the remainder before pushing it to the bottom. All correct.

You may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it into your hand. — expected only the card you take is revealed; the rest of the X cards stay hidden — scripted dig reveal:true reveals ALL X looked-at cards (game.ts:1090). This is the engine's own convention for this exact template — parse.ts:601 emits {take:1, rest:'bottom', order:'random', filter, optional:true, reveal:true} for the identical wording — so the script matches the parser, but it leaks more information than the card does. — CR 701.15

Look at the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of lands you control. — expected X = lands you control, evaluated on resolution — scripted correct — look:{count:'lands-you-control'}; filter types ['Creature','Land'] is any-of (characteristics.ts:222), optional true is the 'You may', rest 'bottom' / order 'random' match. 3/3 scenarios pass. — CR 608.2
